findings.issue: だいたい means 'about/approximately', not 'almost' (which implies just-before-six only). Contradicts the record's own lit_en ('about six o'clock'), pt ('mais ou menos') and both explanations, which teach だいたい = approximately; the parallel sentence 203978 correctly uses 'about'.
Says したら 'follows どう', inverting the actual order: in ダイエットしたらどうだ, したら precedes どう (pattern 〜たらどう). Misleading order description of the target construction; should be 'is followed by どう'.
findings.current: する becomes したら (conditional 〜たら) and follows どう ('how').
findings.suggested: する becomes したら (conditional 〜たら) and is followed by どう ('how').

findings.issue: Diz que したら 'segue どう', invertendo a ordem real: したら vem antes de どう no padrão 〜たらどう. Same inverted-order slip as expl_en; should read 'é seguido de どう'.
findings.current: する vira したら (condicional 〜たら) e segue どう ('como').
findings.suggested: する vira したら (condicional 〜たら) e é seguido de どう ('como').

findings.issue: Dangling cross-reference 'instead of する from the previous sentence': corpus sentence records are standalone, so there is no 'previous sentence'; the clause leaks authoring-batch context and confuses the learner. Grammar content otherwise correct.
findings.current: here 長生き functions as a noun/state + copula だ ('is'), instead of する from the previous sentence.
findings.suggested: here 長生き functions as a noun/state followed by the copula だ ('is').

findings.issue: Referência solta 'em vez do verbo する da frase anterior': o registro é autônomo, não existe 'frase anterior' para o aluno; vazamento de contexto de autoria. Same defect as expl_en.
findings.current: funciona como substantivo/estado seguido da cópula だ ('é'), em vez do verbo する da frase anterior.
findings.suggested: funciona como substantivo/estado seguido da cópula だ ('é').
